title: staged-upgrade-webhook-timeout-and-tenant-kv-rotation-fix
creator: Ava Chen
description: Multiple customers reported failures during staggered on-prem operator upgrades where helm post-install hooks exceeded the webhook handshake deadline and caused a partial reconciliation stall for tenant KV namespaces. This ticket tracks investigation, short-term mitigation for affected tenants, and a short-lived hotpatch to prevent recurrence during the current upgrade window.
acceptance_criteria: New operator image (operator-2.8.1) prevents webhook handshake timeouts in low-resource tenants
Onprem preflight check blocks upgrades when tenant KV tombstones or secret rotations are detected
Automated remediation runbook successfully restores reconciler health within 10 minutes for an affected tenant in staging
No new customer escalations for the same failure mode in the next 72 hours after rollout
steps_to_reproduce: Deploy v2.7.x operator to a constrained single-tenant cluster with KV cache size < 64MB
Trigger a staged upgrade (canary -> majority -> rest) where the canary node runs a secret-rotation job during post-install hooks
Observe helm post-install webhook handshake exceed 30s and operator controller log: 'reconcile loop backoff due to webhook timeout',
Verify tenant-level requests are queued and KV prefix tombstones persist until manual requeue
investigation_summary: Initial triage (2026-03-10) reproduced timeouts in local constrained clusters. Logs show operator controller stuck in an exponential backoff after failed webhook POSTs; kube-apiserver returned 502/504 intermittently during secret-rotation bursts. The helm post-install flow retries write operations to tenant KV namespaces which amplify latency. Correlated with a new secret-rotator cron job customers added (out-of-band) during upgrade windows.
root_cause: Three contributing factors: (1) leader-election jitter + tight webhook handshake deadline caused the operator controller to back off aggressively; (2) tenant KV cache tombstones accumulated when secret-rotation rewrote object UIDs, triggering expensive reconciliation; (3) upgrades were allowed to proceed without preflight detection of ongoing secret-rotation jobs leading to post-install retries against a degraded API path.
proposed_fix: Backport a guard in the operator reconciler to detect webhook deadline exceed and surface a safe non-blocking fallback path
Add a preflight check in the onprem upgrade orchestration that queries tenant controllers for ongoing secret-rotation jobs and KV tombstone levels
Introduce a short-lived exponential-backoff cap and jitter tuning to avoid cascading backoffs during staged upgrades
Ship operator-2.8.1 hotpatch with the above mitigations and release a runbook for affected customers
implemented_changes: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/operator/pull/4213 — reconciler: non-blocking webhook fallback and metrics (merged 2026-03-12)
PR: github.com/redwood-inference/upgrade-orchestrator/pull/78 — preflight: detect secret-rotator active jobs and KV tombstone threshold (merged 2026-03-13)
Config: default webhook_handshake_timeout raised from 30s -> 60s with a feature flag to roll back per-tenant
rollback_plan: If operator-2.8.1 causes regressions, immediately pin clusters back to operator-2.7.x via orchestrator rollback path
Orchestrator supports progressive rollback per-tenant to limit blast radius
Run automatic KV reconciliation job (idempotent) and clear tombstones before reattempting upgrade
Notify customers with staged messaging and provide rolling window for manual abort
monitoring_and_alerting: New SLO alert: webhook_handshake_failure_rate > 0.5% over 5m — PagerDuty oncall
Dashboard: Tenant reconcile latency by KV prefix — Grafana link https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/kv/tenant-reconcile
Heartbeat: upgrade-orchestrator preflight failures tracked in ops-dash (channel #ops-upgrades)
postmortem_actions: Ship KB article for customers describing safe upgrade windows and secret-rotation coordination
Add automated tenant quiesce API that can be called by customers before operator upgrades
Include secret-rotator detection in default onprem cluster template
Schedule a follow-up to validate default webhook timeout across regions and sizing profiles
